text:
emily: FYI partner procurement rejected our AWS Marketplace PO. Reason: PO signer name doesn't match registered vendor contact and they also requested SOC2 Type II attestation attached to the invoice. Deal is in pending state at their procurement queue.
raj: Can you paste the rejection message? We need exact asks to avoid back-and-forth.
emily: quote from partner email:
"PO rejected: signer mismatch (expected registered vendor contact `Cloud Sales Inc. - Contracts`); missing compliance attachment (SOC2 Type II). Please resubmit with matching signer and include SOC2 report or SOC2 attestation reference."
lucas: Is signer mismatch because our legal used an individual name instead of the company contact? We usually put `Redwood Inference, Attn: Contracts` as signer.
emily: They require the signer field to match the vendor registration value `Cloud Sales Inc.`. Their system enforces exact string match for automated reconciliation.
sara: Compliance: we can provide SOC2 Type II summary PDF from last audit, but partner may require a notarized attestation or a link to our Trust Center with a unique ID. Which do they want?
emily: Partner said "attach SOC2 Type II or provide attestation URL with CRC token". They prefer attachment for offline procurement.
raj: Legal/ops decision: easiest path is to update the PO signer to the registered contact string and attach the SOC2 summary. Legal ok with that?
lucas: Ops note  if we change signer to that vendor value it might confuse our internal finance mapping. Anna from finance needs to map payer/signer to our invoice flow or the ingestion will fail.
sara: I'll attach the SOC2 summary PDF but note it's a short-form summary, not the full report. Should we ask partner if short-form is acceptable? Could save time.
emily: They flagged a firm policy: full or certified attestation required for enterprise buys above $100k. This deal is ~120k ARR first year. They said no shortcuts.
raj: Ok then we escalate: (1) emily ask partner for temporary extension (48h) for PO resubmission (2) sara & security to prepare cert attestation PDF (3) lucas/finance to update mapping if signer string changes (4) raj/legal to approve signer string insertion.
emily: Partner can give 48h. They've put the launch milestone on hold until then.
lucas: Finance: If we can't match their signer string exactly, can we include a `registered_vendor_name` metadata field in the PO ingestion to preserve our internal mapping? Example PO payload below.
emily: Pasting proposed PO snippet:
```json
{
  "po_number": "AWS-2026-5541",
  "signer": "Cloud Sales Inc.",
  "billing_account": "AWS-ACCT-998",
  "amount": "120000",
  "attachments": ["redwood_soc2_type2_attestation.pdf"],
  "metadata": {"registered_vendor_name": "Cloud Sales Inc.", "internal_sap_code": "FIN-RED-23"}
}
```
raj: Legal: confirm it's OK to set `signer` to the partner's registered string. We mustn't imply they're accepting our terms or signature. Keep it as "For procurement reconciliation" language.
sara: Security is prepping the attestation. ETA 4 hours to generate the compiled PDF with timestamp and auditor cover page.
aws-marketplace-bot: Validation check: PO ingestion rules require `signer` to match registered_vendor_name OR a `vendor_alias` mapping. No vendor_alias found for Redwood. See https://console.aws.example/marketplace/ingest/AWS-2026-5541
lucas: I'll request partner TAX and vendor registration ID so finance can add a `vendor_alias` mapping if needed.
emily: Action list: emily  ask partner for registration ID + extension (done)
raj  confirm legal language for signer mapping
sara  upload SOC2 attestation PDF and send to partner
lucas  prepare finance vendor_alias mapping if partner provides registration ID
All: target resubmit within 48h to avoid pushing launch window.
raj: I'll review final PO text before sending. Keep channel clean; we'll update when done. :white_check_mark:
